item.description:
Notex 0.2.5
Cloud summaries for longer meetings You can now use GPT-5 Mini through OpenRouter. Open Settings → General → Manage Connections…, choose OpenRouter under Meeting summaries, and add your API key. The key is saved in Keychain on your Mac, and usage is billed to your OpenRouter account. Transcripts and the current note's text are sent to OpenRouter; audio stays on your Mac.
More reliable recording Improved audio saving with Bluetooth microphones and different input formats. Finishing a recording now has time limits so a stalled audio or transcription service cannot leave the recording stuck indefinitely. Available audio and transcript text are preserved when a step fails.
Optional speaker echo reduction Turn on Reduce speaker echo in Settings → Recording to use Apple's voice processing with supported microphones. It is off by default. Headphones remain the most reliable way to keep your voice separate from the other participants.
Faster editing and automatic titles Typing is more responsive, and new recordings can generate short, descriptive note and recording titles from their transcripts. Existing titles you have chosen are preserved.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.4
Clearer summaries for short recordings
- Summaries now need at least 50 transcript words. Short recordings still save normally, with an inline message explaining why a summary is unavailable. - Open Transcript to read a short recording's saved text. The sidebar notice no longer makes the window taller; narrow windows can still widen slightly to fit the sidebar.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.3
Better editing and recording diagnostics
- Improved native editing, table cell selection, and Undo. - Use Insert in Note to add assistant answers while preserving headings and lists. - Choose sorting and date grouping for individual folders. - Finish and save an active recording when quitting Notex. - Added crash reports and recording reliability counts to help investigate failures. Audio, transcripts, and note content are excluded. Turn off Share diagnostic data in Settings > General > Diagnostics to stop sharing. - Refined the app icon, appearance controls, and recording cards.
Requires macOS 26 or later.
